🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF (provided regime). Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, indicating Internal Rotation; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors represented in the Top 5). The breadth and sector data do not independently confirm a strong Risk-Off signal, so treat the supplied label as authoritative while monitoring the mixed evidence.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads on the week (+3.81%); TTWO (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%) is ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary (+2.49%) follows, with BKNG (1W: +8.47% | 1M: +0.44%) and AMZN (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%) ABOVE TREND; Real Estate is third (+1.76%), with no individual stock returns provided.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest (-11.93%), with OXY (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -6.47%) and PSX (1W: -13.12% | 1M: -12.74%) BELOW TREND. Technology (-6.73%) and Utilities (-2.22%) also lag; PLTR (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -19.32%) and INTC (1W: -14.42% | 1M: -47.44%) are BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NEM (1W: +13.41% | 1M: +4.64%), TTWO (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%), SYK (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%), BKNG (1W: +8.47% | 1M: +0.44%) and AMZN (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
OXY (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -6.47%), PLTR (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -19.32%), PSX (1W: -13.12% | 1M: -12.74%), VLO (1W: -13.31% | 1M: -21.94%) and WMB (1W: -13.81% | 1M: -11.42%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Energy, with Technology also represented.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include NEM (1W: +13.41% | 1M: +4.64%) and TTWO (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%), both ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is widespread: GOOGL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%) is in RECOVERY while NVDA (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%) is BELOW TREND; treat short-term rebounds as tactical, not confirmation of a sustained trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 6.73% for the week and 13.12% for the month; sector breadth: 6/11 sectors positive overall, with individual Technology stock breadth unavailable. NVDA (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%) and META (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -15.36%) are BELOW TREND, while MSFT (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +1.53%) is ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%) is in RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed but holding up: sector performance was +0.06% for the week and +2.83% for the month; sector breadth: 6/11 sectors positive overall, with individual Financials stock breadth unavailable. V (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +12.68%) and MA (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +13.73%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +0.93%) is in CORRECTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Monthly strength persists (+9.15%), despite a nearly flat week (+0.14%); sector breadth: 6/11 sectors positive overall, with individual Healthcare stock breadth unavailable. SYK (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) and JNJ (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +7.70%) are ABOVE TREND, while LLY (1W: -4.48% | 1M: +15.77%) and UNH (1W: -3.15% | 1M: +6.25%) are in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Stance?
Favor relative strength in Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary, while reducing exposure to weak Energy and Technology names selectively. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major cross-timeframe divergence argues for measured positioning and confirmation before making broad style shifts.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor JNJ (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +7.70%, ABOVE TREND) for follow-through on its FDA catalyst, and TTWO (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%, ABOVE TREND) for price resilience despite a negative analyst target revision.
BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%, BELOW TREND) and INTC (1W: -14.42% | 1M: -47.44%, BELOW TREND) for continued technology weakness; TSLA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%, BELOW TREND) also faces negative vehicle-mix headlines.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor Healthcare, up 9.15% over the month, and Consumer Discretionary, up 8.06%; overall breadth is 6/11 sectors positive, so confirm whether participation broadens.
BEARISH: Technology, down 13.12% over the month, and Energy, down 7.00%, remain weak; individual sector stock breadth was not supplied.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not provided. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%, BELOW TREND) stabilizes after its decline, whether GOOGL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%, RECOVERY) sustains its rebound, and whether JPM (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +0.93%, CORRECTION) and AAPL (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.57%, CORRECTION) regain positive weekly momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): FDA accelerated approval for an advanced head-and-neck cancer therapy; JNJ (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +7.70%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. GE (+50): reported $12.9 billion in China aerospace deals; GE (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +5.77%) is ABOVE TREND, also confirming the news.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TTWO (-45): analyst price target cut, but TTWO (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%) remains ABOVE TREND, a price/news divergence to monitor. TSLA (-35): plans to discontinue iconic vehicles; TSLA (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%) is BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. MCD (-35): testing value meals amid falling sales, while MCD (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +16.72%) is ABOVE TREND, a notable divergence.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF is the supplied regime; breadth is 6/11 sectors positive and style is mixed, with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership. Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary show relative strength, including SYK (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%, ABOVE TREND) and AMZN (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%, ABOVE TREND). Major trend divergence warrants caution: monitor GOOGL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%, RECOVERY) and TTWO (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +2.63%, ABOVE TREND) against their respective news and price signals.
